standard_rules.internal_processing: All quantitative computations, returns, turnovers, costs, and alpha spreads must be stored and computed in pure DECIMAL form (e.g., 0.01 for 1%, 0.001 for 10 bps, 0.0385 for 3.85% turnover).
standard_rules.display_layer: Outputs presented in tables/markdown must explicitly denote units with % or bps (e.g., 9.31%, 20 bps). Annualized turnover must be reported as turns/year (e.g. 9.32x) or percentage (e.g. 932%), never conflating a multiplier with a fractional percentage.
